page.overview:
What is Wood?

Stripped wood or stripped hyphae is a variant obtained when any axe is on wood or hyphae respectively.

Wood also have many uses, ranged from building to crafting some other construction materials and items.

Wood and hyphae can be broken by hand, but using an axe is the fastest.

Oak wood and stripped oak wood generate in plains villages.
